title: ICAB V1 - Corporate Reporting
summary: Mastery of complex IFRS/IAS/IFRIC standards, group reporting with foreign subsidiaries, complex financial instruments, business valuations, advanced audit and forensic assurance, and IFRS Sustainability Standards (S1/S2).

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Corporate Reporting. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Complex Corporate Reporting – Compliance
stages.name: Area 1: Complex Corporate Reporting – Compliance
stages.description: Complex IFRS/IAS (IFRS 9, IFRS 15, IFRS 16, IAS 19, IAS 21 foreign currency, step acquisitions).

nodes.name: Complex Financial Instruments (IFRS 9) & Employee Benefits (IAS 19)
nodes.description: IFRS 9 classification and measurement (Amortized Cost, FVOCI, FVTPL); Expected Credit Loss (ECL) 3-stage model; hedge accounting (fair value hedges, cash flow hedges); IAS 19 Employee Benefits: Defined benefit pension schemes, actuarial gains/losses, asset ceiling.
topics: IFRS 9 Business model test and SPPI (Solely Payments of Principal and Interest) cash flow test
Financial liabilities: Amortized cost vs fair value option and credit risk treatment
Expected Credit Loss (ECL) impairment: Stage 1 (12-month), Stage 2 (lifetime), Stage 3 (default)
Hedge accounting requirements: Designated hedging instrument, hedged item, hedge ratio, testing
Cash flow hedge reserve accounting vs fair value hedge adjustments
IAS 19 Defined Benefit plans: Present value of obligation, plan assets, service costs
Remeasurements through OCI and asset ceiling test (IFRIC 14)
learningOutcomes: Apply IFRS 9 ECL model to banking and corporate loan portfolios.
Account for complex derivatives and cash flow hedges.
Calculate defined benefit pension liabilities and OCI remeasurements.
checklists: Read Complex Financial Instruments (IFRS 9) & Employee Benefits (IAS 19) in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

nodes.name: Advanced Group Accounts: Step Acquisitions & Foreign Subsidiaries (IAS 21)
nodes.description: Step acquisitions (associate becoming subsidiary); partial disposals retaining control or losing control; foreign currency translation of overseas subsidiaries (IAS 21: Closing rate method, exchange differences in OCI); group statement of cash flows; joint arrangements (IFRS 11).
topics: Step acquisitions: Remeasuring previously held interest to fair value through P&L
Disposal of subsidiary with loss of control: Derecognition, fair value of retained interest, gain/loss calculation
Disposal without loss of control: Equity transaction with NCI, no gain/loss in P&L
IAS 21 Foreign currency translation: Functional currency determination
Translating foreign subsidiary financial statements: Closing rate for B/S, average rate for P&L, translation reserve in OCI
Group Statement of Cash Flows: Acquisitions, disposals, foreign exchange effects on cash balances
IFRS 11 Joint Arrangements: Joint Operations vs Joint Ventures (equity method)
learningOutcomes: Prepare group accounts for step acquisitions and partial disposals.
Translate foreign subsidiary financial statements and compute exchange reserves.
Construct group consolidated cash flow statements.
checklists: Read Advanced Group Accounts: Step Acquisitions & Foreign Subsidiaries (IAS 21) in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Financial Statement Analysis & Valuation
stages.name: Area 2: Financial Statement Analysis & Valuation
stages.description: Multi-year earnings quality, financial distress modeling (Altman Z-score), and entity valuation.

nodes.name: Earnings Quality, Distress Prediction & Valuation
nodes.description: Earnings quality analysis; aggressive revenue recognition detection; Beneish M-Score and Altman Z-Score financial distress models; enterprise valuation synthesizing discounted cash flows and market multiples for M&A transactions.
topics: Evaluating earnings quality: Accruals quality, persistence, and cash flow backing
Detecting financial statement manipulation using Beneish M-Score indicators
Bankruptcy prediction models: Altman Z-Score for manufacturing and service entities
Adjusted Present Value (APV) method for highly leveraged buyouts
Enterprise valuation under complex capital structures and cross-holding adjustments
learningOutcomes: Audit earnings quality and identify manipulation signals.
Calculate Altman Z-score to predict insolvency risk.
Value acquisition targets in cross-border takeovers.
checklists: Read Earnings Quality, Distress Prediction & Valuation in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: Audit & Assurance in Complex Environments
stages.name: Area 3: Audit & Assurance in Complex Environments
stages.description: Advanced auditing of complex groups, forensic accounting, transnational audit, and audit opinions.

nodes.name: Group Audits (ISA 600), Forensic Investigations & Reporting
nodes.description: ISA 600 (Revised) Audits of Group Financial Statements: Component auditors, group materiality, consolidation adjustments; forensic accounting investigations and fraud evidence; transnational auditing challenges; audit reporting on complex groups.
topics: ISA 600 (Revised): Group auditor responsibilities, component identification, communication
Evaluating work of component auditors and determining component materiality
Auditing consolidation journals, goodwill impairment tests, and foreign exchange reserves
Forensic investigation techniques: Interviewing, digital evidence forensics, asset tracing
Auditing transnational and multinational entities with divergent regulatory frameworks
Complex auditor reporting: Group audit opinion modifications, emphasis of matters, KAM synthesis
learningOutcomes: Lead group audit engagements in compliance with ISA 600 (Revised).
Design forensic audit procedures for suspected corporate fraud.
Formulate audit opinions for complex global corporate groups.
checklists: Read Group Audits (ISA 600), Forensic Investigations & Reporting in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 4: Public Financial Management & Sustainability (ISSB)
stages.name: Area 4: Public Financial Management & Sustainability (ISSB)
stages.description: IFRS S1 and S2 sustainability disclosures, ESG metrics assurance, and public sector governance.

nodes.name: IFRS S1/S2 Sustainability Disclosures & ESG Assurance
nodes.description: IFRS S1 General Requirements for Disclosure of Sustainability-related Financial Information; IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures (Scope 1, 2, and 3 greenhouse gas emissions); assurance on sustainability reports under ISSA 5000; public sector financial reporting and IPSAS.
topics: IFRS S1 Core content: Governance, Strategy, Risk Management, Metrics and Targets
IFRS S2 Climate disclosures: Physical climate risks, transition risks, scenario analysis
Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Protocol: Scope 1 (direct), Scope 2 (electricity), Scope 3 (value chain)
Independent assurance on ESG disclosures under ISSA 5000 General Requirements
Public Financial Management (PFM) reforms and IPSAS implementation in government entities
learningOutcomes: Structure corporate sustainability disclosures under IFRS S1 and S2.
Compute and report Scope 1, 2, and 3 GHG emissions.
Plan an assurance engagement on sustainability reports under ISSA 5000.
checklists: Read IFRS S1/S2 Sustainability Disclosures & ESG Assurance in ICAB Study Manual
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
